messages:
maria: Heads-up — draft release notes for tomorrow's rollout are posted in the doc. Need a quick ops preflight + locale check from EU/APAC teams. Can someone confirm we can ship the micro-copy in pt-BR and fr-FR?

jordan: On it. I'll run the checklist against the staging build. ETA 20m.

lena: Quick note — are we pinning model to `inference-v3.2` for this rollout? If not, we should, to avoid divergence during canary.

maria: Yes pin to `inference-v3.2`. I'll add that to the RN bullets.

ops-oncall: Confirming staging tests passed for default region. Can verify locales after jordan's smoke. Rollback plan is the usual: immediate pin rollback to `inference-v3.1` + scale down canary. Link to playbook: https://internal/playbooks/release-rollback

deploy-bot: deploy queued — staging -> canary window starting in 10m. Canary target: 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 15m. Operator: @ops-oncall.

jordan: Staging smoke done. Found one l10n truncation in pt-BR (email subject). Pushed a tiny copy fix to the staging branch. Patch is safe to merge into release branch.

lena: Please add an RN line: "Fixed localized email subject truncation for pt-BR during onboarding flows." Also add note about pinned model.

maria: Good catch. Added those two lines to the RN and updated the internal announcement draft. Copy snippet below for confirmation: 
```
Internal: Tomorrow 10:00 UTC - We will roll out release 2026.03.22 (inference-v3.2 pinned). Minor l10n fix for pt-BR. No user-facing downtime expected.
If issues arise, ops will rollback to inference-v3.1 and pause rollout.
```

ops-oncall: Looks good. One ask — add the contact list for regional oncalls in the announcement (EU: @lena, APAC: @jordan).

maria: Done. Draft updated.

dev-deploy-bot: Canary started. Logs: https://deploys/internal/9487654321/canary — observed latency within SLOs. Monitoring alert thresholds set.

lena: Canary metrics look clean from our side. No error spikes, token cost within expected range. :thumbsup:

jordan: Locale fix validated in staging for pt-BR and fr-FR. Ready to promote to canary.

ops-oncall: Standby window noted. If anything crosses >5% error or latency >200ms p95, we'll abort and rollback.

maria: Thanks team. I'll send the internal announce at T-30 and post the RN to the staff channel. Anyone who wants to tweak wording speak now.

lena: LGTM.

jordan: All good from eng.

maria: Final: sending internal announce in 30. :rocket:
